blocks.text: The family of Ate Gay called out false claims about the comedian’s supposed death, clarifying that he is alive and continues to fight for his life. “We have been receiving messages saying ‘Rest in Peace’ and ‘Condolences’ regarding our beloved Ate Gay, along with false and misleading information circulating on social media. PLEASE UNDERSTAND THAT HE IS STILL ALIVE AND CONTINUES TO FIGHT FOR HIS LIFE,” they said through a statement released on Saturday, Oct. 31, on the comedian’s Facebook page under his real name Gil Aducal Morales. “We sincerely ask everyone to refrain from spreading fake news, unverified information, and […]...
